candidate.answerReason: The six possible visible products have greatest common divisor 12, agreeing with choice B.

methods.label: List the possible products
methods.explanation:
Only the bottom face is hidden. Since the product of all six face numbers is \(1\cdot2\cdot3\cdot4\cdot5\cdot6=720\), a hidden number \(h\) gives \(P=720/h\). The hidden number can be any of \(1,2,3,4,5,6\), so the complete list of possible products is
\[
720,\ 360,\ 240,\ 180,\ 144,\ 120.
\]
A number certain to divide \(P\) must divide every number on this list. All six are divisible by \(12\). To show that no larger common divisor works, consider just three of them:
\[
\gcd(144,120)=24,\qquad \gcd(24,180)=12.
\]
Thus every guaranteed divisor must divide \(12\), and \(12\) itself always works. The largest such number is \(\boxed{12}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Listing six products and finding their greatest common factor uses elementary arithmetic.
